title: NFL Football
description:
Baltimore Ravens at Buffalo Bills
The Buffalo Bills host the Baltimore Ravens in NFL regular-season play at Highmark Stadium. At 5-1, Buffalo welcomes a Baltimore side that dropped to 4-3 after a 35-13 home loss to Cincinnati. Buffalo aims for a three-game win streak.

title: NFL Football
description:
New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins
The Dolphins (1-5) host the Patriots (4-3) in an NFL regular-season game at Hard Rock Stadium. Miami enters after a narrow 28-25 road win over the Jets, while New England has won three of its last four games despite a 30-24 loss to Chicago last week.
